integrity: Includes a fully self-contained C++17 verifier for complete enumeration, Kempe adjacency, all-source BFS and metric profiles; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation only for the dodecahedral vertex three-colouring graph and its global-colour quotient; no claim on all cubic graphs. Literature comparison cannot exclude uncatalogued computations.
title: Sharp Kempe distances for dodecahedral vertex three-colourings
